claude-haiku-5-5.note: added 2026-10-18 from the pricing, prompt-caching and models-overview pages (ID claude-haiku-5-5). Prices are the tier for prompts up to 100,000 tokens (in 0.10, out 0.50, cache hit 0.1x = 0.01). A request whose prompt is over 100,000 tokens, counting cache reads and writes, pays in 0.50, out 2.50 and cache hit 0.05; that tier is not modelled, so such a request fails the 1 per cent cost assertion rather than being mispriced silently. The any/tool figure 406 sits in an unnamed row directly under the Haiku 5.5 row of the tool-overhead table and is read as belonging to it, as in the model pricing table. Cache hits use the table default 0.1x (the caching page names no exception). tokenizer_factor 1.3 follows the page statement for Claude 4.7 and later.

notes.region_us_only: inference_geo='us' applies 1.1x to input, output, cache writes and cache reads on Claude 4.6 and later. Global routing is the default and is standard-priced.
notes.long_context_surcharge: Claude 4.6 and later models except Claude Haiku 5.5 include the full 1M context window at standard pricing: a 900k request bills at the same per-token rate as a 9k one. No threshold, hence 1.0. Claude Haiku 5.5 is priced by prompt length (over 100,000 tokens pays higher prices); see its model note, only the lower tier is modelled.
notes.tool_overhead: Tokens added to every tool-enabled request by the automatic tool-use system prompt. 'auto' covers tool_choice auto and none; 'any' covers any and tool. Tool definitions and tool_result blocks bill on top of this.
notes.cache_read_mult: Per-model cache-hit multiplier where the caching page lists an exception: Opus 5.5 and Sonnet 5.5 0.05x, Fable 5.1 and Mythos 5.1 0.025x. Others use multipliers.cache_read.
notes.tokenizer_factor: Claude 4.7 and later use a tokenizer producing approximately 30% more tokens for the same text; 1.0 for earlier models such as Haiku 4.5.
notes.not_added: Mythos 5.1 and Mythos 5 are priced on the pricing page (10.0/50.0 as recorded on 2026-10-01) but are invitation only with no public API model ID, so they stay out of the table. Fable 5.1 was added on 2026-10-01 with its ID confirmed on the models overview page and re-verified on 2026-10-18.
notes.fast_mode: Opus 5.5 fast mode is 8.0/40.0; Opus 5 and Opus 4.8 fast mode is 10.0/50.0. Not modelled; add a model entry if you adopt it.
notes.server_tools: Web search bills $10 per 1,000 searches; code execution has 1,550 free hours a month per organisation, then $0.05 per container-hour.
notes.subscription: Claude Max and other subscription sessions are not billed per token; figures for them are list-price comparisons, never spend.
notes.region_us: inference_geo 'us' pricing applies to Claude 4.6 and later only; models marked region_us false raise rather than price it.
